subject: normalisation of samples within a condition

messages.author: 83bd88e4ae3399fb
messages.subject: normalisation of samples within a condition
parts:
Hi MSstats team,

 

I would like to normalise a dataset by condition instead of across all the samples. This would be useful for experiments with vastly different conditions where the assumption that the majority of the proteins are not changing can not be made.

 

Would there be an option for this?

 

Many thanks,

Silvia

messages.author: 2889aa2e61425c8e
messages.subject: Re: normalisation of samples within a condition
parts:
Hi Silvia,

This is not a good idea. This is because a separate normalization in each group will introduce between-group differences, which will confound the true biological changes. In other words, you will not be able to distinguish the artifacts of normalization from changes in abundance. A good solution for normalization in this case is to use one (or a small number of) internal standards.

HTH
My best wishes
Olga
